dedupe_keys.name: ciens convection permitting ensemble forecasts and station observations

description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology's RADAR4KIT archive publishes CIENS, a German Weather Service COSMO and ICON ensemble forecast collection at observation sites. It covers December 2010 to June 2023, with two daily initializations and hourly lead times from zero to 21 hours. Forecasts include 55 meteorological variables, spatial summaries for a subset and observations of six variables at 170 German stations. The own DOI metadata lists four TAR packages and a CC BY 4.0 licence; the public record is free to inspect. Precipitation, wind and temperature scenarios can provide boundary conditions for stormwater, electricity and transport disruption simulations, and station pairs can calibrate forecast-error models. These are historical forecasts at selected stations, not an uninterrupted grid or a prospective operational feed. COSMO-to-ICON changes and station coverage need care when comparing years. The article's related GitHub repository offers context but does not turn this data product into a separately published infrastructure model. CIENS complements data-era5-reanalysis with short-range ensembles and paired observations. No TAR package was downloaded.
